content.value_statement: Slow pages hurt conversion, SEO, and user experience. This skill guides audits, Core Web Vitals fixes, bundle reductions, image optimization, and caching work.
actual_capabilities: Builds a measurement-first audit plan using Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, bundle size, and network waterfall data.
Identifies likely causes of slow LCP, high input delay, layout shifts, and long main-thread tasks.
Suggests code splitting, lazy loading, dependency replacement, and third-party script deferral strategies.
Provides image optimization guidance for modern formats, responsive images, lazy loading, and fixed dimensions.
Recommends caching, CDN usage, compression, and monitoring practices for sustained performance improvements.
limitations: It cannot measure a live application without access to performance reports, source files, or tool output.
Examples must be adapted to the project framework, hosting platform, and deployment pipeline.
It does not replace production monitoring or real user measurement data.
It cannot guarantee SEO, conversion, or revenue outcomes from performance changes.

use_cases.title: Fix Core Web Vitals Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose poor LCP, FID, CLS, TTFB, or TTI results and create a prioritized remediation plan.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Performance Audit
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable audit checklist that covers Lighthouse, mobile throttling, assets, bundles, caching, and monitoring.

use_cases.title: Reduce Page Weight
use_cases.description: Find opportunities to shrink JavaScript, optimize images, defer scripts, and improve load time on slower networks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Slow Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my page symptoms and create a prioritized performance audit plan. Focus on Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, images, scripts, and caching.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Bundle Size
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my bundle report and suggest the highest impact reductions. Include dependency replacements, code splitting, lazy loading, and unused code checks.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Web Vitals Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these before and after performance metrics. Identify likely regressions, rank causes by impact, and propose verification steps for each fix.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Performance Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a performance budget, monitoring plan, review checklist, and release gate for our web application. Include ownership and recurring measurement.

output_examples.input: A landing page has LCP above four seconds and large hero images.
output: Prioritized finding: optimize the hero image first because it is the likely LCP element.
Recommended actions: serve AVIF or WebP, preload the above-the-fold asset, set dimensions, and use a CDN.
Verification: rerun Lighthouse on mobile throttling and compare LCP against the baseline.

output_examples.input: A React application has a large main bundle and slow interactivity.
output: Prioritized finding: reduce main-thread JavaScript before lower impact asset work.
Recommended actions: split routes, lazy load admin and chart views, replace heavy dependencies, and defer analytics.
Verification: compare bundle analyzer output, Time to Interactive, and interaction latency after each change.

output_examples.input: A team wants a release checklist for performance quality.
output: Checklist focus: Core Web Vitals, compressed assets, image dimensions, script loading, cache headers, and mobile throttling.
Process guidance: define budgets, assign owners, and track results in release notes.
Monitoring guidance: combine lab audits with real user measurements for production validation.

best_practices: Measure baseline performance before changing code, then verify each optimization against the same conditions.
Prioritize fixes that improve Core Web Vitals and mobile user experience before cosmetic micro-optimizations.
Keep performance work repeatable with budgets, checklists, monitoring, and clear ownership.
anti_patterns: Optimizing without a baseline or user-impact metric.
Shipping large JavaScript bundles and third-party scripts before critical content is interactive.
Testing only on fast desktop devices while ignoring mobile networks and real user data.

faq.question: Does this skill run Lighthouse automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and example commands, but tool execution depends on the user environment and permissions.

faq.question: Can it help with Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on LCP, FID, CLS, TTFB, and TTI diagnosis with practical remediation steps.

faq.question: What inputs make the analysis better?
faq.answer: Provide Lighthouse reports, WebPageTest results, bundle analyzer output, source files, screenshots, and production metrics when available.

faq.question: Is it only for React or Next.js?
faq.answer: No. Some examples use React and Next.js, but the audit process applies to most web applications.

faq.question: Can it optimize images?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers compression, responsive images, modern formats, dimensions, lazy loading, and above-the-fold priority.

faq.question: Does it replace monitoring tools?
faq.answer: No. It helps interpret results and plan fixes, but teams still need lab testing and real user monitoring.
